answer: The swordsmith’s forge burns bright, and the steel bars lie heating in the coals. Proof of swordsmith via blade tally — a blade the swordsmith forges only after 41 blades hold their edge without one notching at the point, each forged by the swordsmith himself. wander draws the bar out and hammers the edge thin. island folds the steel and welds the layers true. comet quenches the blade and tests it on the cutting post. Forty-one blades must hold their edge without one notching at the point, and the next still notches where the temper ran soft.
